lessons_used: Evidence is still thin to establish rules on which changes work or prediction accuracy.

candidates.title: Interactive Pet Personality Selector
candidates.change: Rebuild the pick_friend screen into a stage layout with animated choice cards highlighting pet behaviors and temperament traits.
candidates.why: Adoption has a low 60.9% conversion rate and high mean time (1017s); interactive choices help users connect faster.

pick_friend.headline: Meet Your New Companion
pick_friend.body: Select a friend whose personality matches your workflow and daily rhythm.

guard.reason: Valid redesign of the pick_friend screen retaining choice functionality.

candidates.score_note: Target step loses 39.1% users, but prior redesign test yielded -6.5% lift.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Controls Walkthrough Screen
candidates.change: Add a new screen after waiting that visually explains how to interact, minimize, and talk to your pet on the desktop.
candidates.why: Multiple support emails (3 emails) indicate post-onboarding confusion around controlling and hiding desktop pets.

new_desktop_guide.headline: How to Interact with Your Pet
new_desktop_guide.body: Right-click your pet on the desktop to open settings, talk, or temporarily hide them in your system tray.

guard.reason: Valid addition of an instructional screen within onboarding after waiting.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from 3 support emails, but adding a screen increases friction and cost.

candidates.title: Late Sign-In After Pet Adoption
candidates.change: Move the sign_in step to occur right after pet adoption certificate so users build emotional attachment before account setup.
candidates.why: Sign_in drops 27.1% of users early; moving it later leverages investment in their newly created pet.

sign_in.headline: Save Your New Pet to Cloud
sign_in.body: Create or sign into your account to back up your companion and access them across devices.

guard.reason: Valid reordering of the sign_in step within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Reordering sign-in reduces early friction by leveraging pet creation investment.

candidates.title: Pet Style Verification Flow
candidates.change: Add a dedicated pet verification screen before adoption certificate so users review and approve custom pet rendering.
candidates.why: Support receives 3 emails about custom pet generation failing or looking unexpected.

new_style_confirm.headline: Review Your Custom Pet
new_style_confirm.body: Take a quick look at your pet's appearance before signing the official adoption certificate.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a style confirmation screen before adoption certificate.

candidates.score_note: Addresses render complaints, but adding another step can lower adoption rate.

candidates.title: Path Duration and Feature Comparison Hint
candidates.change: Add clear time estimates and path comparison hints to help users choose between quick adoption and custom creation.
candidates.why: Choose_path has a high mean time of 514s (8.5 mins), showing decision paralysis during path selection.

choose_path.hint: Preset pets take 30 seconds to setup. Custom pet creation takes 2 minutes.

guard.reason: Valid addition of time estimate hints on choose_path.

candidates.score_note: Low cost hint addresses high 514s decision time on path selection.

candidates.title: Desktop Setup Progress and Live Tips Carousel
candidates.change: Display explicit progress percentages and a tip carousel explaining desktop integration while the pet renders.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a long mean wait time (2336s) and 3 support complaints mention pets failing to appear.

waiting.headline: Preparing Your Desktop Companion
waiting.body: We are calibrating animations and screen boundaries for your workspace.

guard.reason: Valid addition of progress details and tips to the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: High wait time (2336s mean) and 3 complaints support adding wait-time info.

candidates.title: Clear Desktop System Tray Control Instructions
candidates.change: Update home_intro text to clearly detail shortcut keys and system tray behavior for calling or hiding the pet.
candidates.why: Finish step drops 35.2% of remaining users and support notes confusion on controlling/hiding pets post-setup.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!
home_intro.body: Click your pet to interact, or find the pet icon in your system tray to summon, hide, or adjust pet settings anytime.

guard.reason: Valid copy update to home_intro screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Finish drops 35.2%; copy fix directly addresses support complaints at low cost.

candidates.title: Exclusive Accessory Unlocks Incentive Badge
candidates.change: Add a prominent reward badge on choose_path advertising a free bonus starter item upon completing setup.
candidates.why: Overall onboarding completion is low at 17.8%; early incentives drive users through the funnel.

components.text: Bonus: Free Desktop Toy Set Included!

guard.reason: Onboarding copy explicitly mentions a 'Free' bonus extra, violating Rule 3.

candidates.title: Desktop Ready System Notification Switch
candidates.change: Enable desktop notification alert toggle on the waiting screen so users get pinged when setup completes.
candidates.why: Waiting step takes median 201s / mean 2336s, causing users to switch windows and drop off.

waiting.hint: Feel free to use other apps; we'll notify you when your pet is ready on your screen.

guard.reason: Valid addition of notification settings on the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Notifications bring back users who switch away during long 201s median wait.

candidates.title: Account Persistence Clarification Layout
candidates.change: Redesign sign_in to a card layout highlighting auto-save benefits and preventing accidental pet resets.
candidates.why: 8 support tickets reported missing or reset pets after signing in again, making account save benefits critical.

sign_in.headline: Secure Your Pet & Progress
sign_in.body: Sign in to keep your pet saved safely so you never lose your companion.

guard.reason: 'sign_in.replace.sign_in_options[0]': nothing on the sign-in screen may lead past it without signing in

held_by_harm_budget: Clear Desktop System Tray Control Instructions
Desktop Setup Progress and Live Tips Carousel
Path Duration and Feature Comparison Hint
lessons_next: Evidence is still thin to establish rules on which kinds of change work or fail, as each kind of change has only one test.
Predictions were consistently too high: both tests predicted positive gains (+14.0% and +6.0%), but both resulted in negative outcomes (-7.2% after noise correction).
